industrial.cfo_pat: annual operating cash flow / annual PAT

industrial.revenue_yoy: comparable quarter revenue / prior-year same quarter revenue - 1
industrial.pat_yoy: comparable quarter PAT / prior-year same quarter PAT - 1

industrial: annual PAT / contemporaneous raw price * verified shares (denominator product)

feature_definitions.price_features: Use unchanged factor_v1_features_1.0.5; all lookbacks are exchange sessions

normalization.price: Recompute V1 cross-section normalization on the covered universe
normalization.fundamentals: Within dated entity groups, winsorize 1%/99%; median/MAD z using 1.4826; clip +/-3; average directed fields within blocks
normalization.zero_mad: Observed constant inputs map to zero; missing inputs never map to zero

missing_data_rules.fundamentals: Exclude incomplete block rows; no neutral imputation
missing_data_rules.shares: Value missing unless PIT value_feature_valid is true
missing_data_rules.unsupported_entities: Exclude from V2; retain in full V1 denominator

coverage_policy.denominator: Dated PIT eligible universe; top 100 by contemporaneous ADV60
coverage_policy.shares: Same per-cutoff thresholds and continuity as filings
coverage_policy.feature_completeness: Every signal cutoff including prior month-close at first OOS open

training_policy.method: Fixed predeclared deterministic block weights; no fitted training or weight optimization
training_policy.validation: Every declared outer window; no best-window selection
training_policy.label: 63-session Nifty-500-relative forward price return; no future labels before maturity
